EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a simple aliphatic pattern: three strong bands at 2879–2937 cm⁻¹ consistent with sp³ C–H stretches and a band at 1450 cm⁻¹ consistent with CH₂/CH₃ bending (GFQ-003). There is no evidence for N–H stretches (~3200–3500 cm⁻¹) or NH₂ scissoring (~1600 cm⁻¹), disfavoring candidates with N–H. Azide-containing options (6, 7) would show a strong ~2100 cm⁻¹ band, which is absent. Candidate 4 (an ether with only sp³ C–H and no N–H/O–H) best matches the observed Raman features.
